# These fixtures are synthetic

Every file here was written by hand from the structure described in docs/boards/jobbank.md. None is a capture of the real
board. The reason: on 2026-10-19 jobbank.dk answered robots.txt and the RSS feed with a Cloudflare "Just a moment..." 403
from this machine, and we do not work around that, so no real response could be saved.

All companies, people, postings, ids (9xxxxx) and texts are fictional. `cloudflare_challenge.html` imitates the shape of the
challenge page (title and markers only), to prove such a page is reported as blocked and never parsed.

When a real capture can be made from a permitted network, replace these files (keeping the names) and rerun the tests;
the checklist of what to capture is section 8 of docs/boards/jobbank.md.
